rawFindings.title: Incorrect port assignment logic in parseProxyConfig
rawFindings.explanation: The new lines incorrectly redefine the 'port' variable using an expression that accesses 'proxyDetails.port' without checking whether it exists, conflicting with the previous conditionals. The logic has been replaced with a single line which still uses 'proxyDetails.port' but wrongly prioritizes 'config.port' before the protocol default ports, and does not maintain the previous conditional checks consistently, potentially leading to incorrect port assignment.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the previous multi-branch conditional check assigning 'port' to 'proxyDetails.port' if present, else to the default port based on 'proxyDetails.protocol' if defined, else to 'config.port'. This preserves the correct precedence for port selection.
